disposition.fix: founder_activity counts only founder paths (answers, preferences/refusals, authorizations, revocations/supersessions); reviews and resolutions live in accountable_parties with their actors and their own headline sentence

findings.title: New closure honesty assertions are tautologies and cannot fail

findings.title: Resurfaced deferred ask is reported as deferred, not waiting
findings.claim: asks_upto/answers_upto are keyed by item_id and the entry is classified solely by the latest ANSWER (lines 225-237). A decision the founder deferred is re-routed by FounderAttentionRouter.route() once resurface_after passes (a second ASK_RECORD with the same item_id; the router then holds it in _open as a waiting decision), but the fold still sees answer.decision == 'defer' and files it under deferred_as_of_until. decisions_waiting_as_of_until, per_goal.decisions_waiting and the headline '{n} decision(s) exceed delegated authority and wait for you' undercount by one per resurfaced ask, and the deferred entry pairs the new routed_at with a resurface_after that is already in the past. schedule.py (lines 56-63) gets this right by taking the latest of ask/answer in ledger order; absence.py does not.

Add a unit test mirroring test_a_deferred_ask_is_scheduled_to_resurface that asserts the resurfaced item is in decisions_waiting_as_of_until and not in deferred_as_of_until.

disposition.fix: asks and answers are folded in ledger order per item (as WakeSchedule does); an item whose latest record is an ask is open again

findings.title: goals_completed / active_in_window re-report a goal in any later window that merely transitions it
findings.claim: completed_in_window selects every TRANSITION_RECORD with state.status == 'completed' and last_reviewed_at in the window, and statuses_in_window/active (lines 362-363, 381) count any transition. GoalRegistry.transition() accepts a completed goal, and verify_outcome/_apply_verification (gravity.py 1176) and reconcile() transition it, so a verification days after completion writes a 'completed' TRANSITION_RECORD dated at verification time. A window containing only that verification reports learned.goals_completed = [goal], goals.active_in_window = 1 and the headline '1 of 1 authorized goal(s) were active: 0 goal-processing(s) across 0 turn(s)', although nothing completed or was processed in that window.
